messages.subject: GPSC | Clean power, battery systems and institutional execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Leepagorn and GPSC Leadership Team,

GPSC's role across power, utilities and clean-energy growth is closely aligned with my experience leading the stakeholder and governance dimensions of industrial energy transition.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy in a complex operating environment.

My recent work includes support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness based on physical operating evidence. I also coordinate regulatory submissions, inspections, official engagements, community priorities and cross-functional corrective action. This gives me a practical understanding of what clean-energy growth requires beyond technical design.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities in External Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or Country Strategy. I have attached a GPSC-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
